note: Every arm scored on the identical held-out rows. Laya numbers come from the saved checkpoint via eval_cifar.py, never from laya-train's console report -- which disagreed with the artifact (0.033 against 0.873) until v0.4.47 fixed two defects behind that number.

laya.verdict: collapsed to the uniform prior in four configurations (16/64 visual tokens, frozen/trainable encoder)

laya.checkpoint: 10k items, 4 epochs, frozen tower + frozen encoder, 16 visual tokens, joint layout

defects_found: visual_plan promises one more visual token than PooledProjector emits above summary_for_options_over (96 rendered option tokens), so a >~30-option vision head cannot be built
that summary token, when enabled, shifts every marker by +1 while _cat inserts the block after all of them: 0/100 markers land on a [MASK] token
Agent.predict_batch raises KeyError: 'visual' on a batch that mixes an image state with a text-only one (laya/vision.py collate_visual), which makes a batched gate-1 ablation impossible

laya-train's before/after table scored a text-only evaluation of the image rows and never loaded the base checkpoint's projector: it printed 0.0333 for a checkpoint that measures 0.8728 (fixed in v0.4.47)
predict_batch raised KeyError: 'visual' on a batch mixing an image state with a text state, which made a batched image-ablation gate impossible (fixed in v0.4.48)

visual_plan reserved a [VIS_SUMMARY] token that PooledProjector never emitted, so any head over ~30 options refused to build; and it shifted every marker by one for an insertion that never happens, putting 0 of 100 markers on a [MASK] (fixed in v0.4.50)
caveats: single seed except the 20-way x 64-visual-token check (collapsed at seed 31, learned at seed 77)
predict_batch timing on image states was inconsistent across configurations; not investigated

layout_comparison.note: The layout the spec says ships (state_conditioned: one option per row) measured against the joint layout on identical data, seed and epoch budget. Same 2000-item class-balanced stride (1800 after the calibration slice), seed 77, frozen tower and frozen text encoder, scored on the full 5000-row 20-way held-out split.

state_conditioned_2k_3ep.comment: undertrained: this layout builds k rows per item, so 3 epochs is far too few

state_conditioned_2k_10ep.comment: the first checkpoint in this repository to pass both gates on real data

layout_comparison.caveat: single-seed; of four identical joint-layout runs started for this measurement three collapsed to the class prior (mean loss pinned to ln 20) and one learned. Only the first two arms are a data-matched comparison.
